name: School
definition: An individual California public school record, identified by a 14-character CDS code. In the school directory the same entity can appear with status Active, Closed, Merged or Pending.
scope: School-level analysis across the school directory (tab03) and the 2014-2015 FRPM reporting table (tab01).

name: School District
definition: A local educational agency that operates one or more schools. A district is identified by its district name together with its county; 15 district names occur in more than one county, so a name alone does not uniquely identify a district.
scope: District-level grouping and district-name filters such as Fresno Unified.

name: County
definition: California county (58 distinct values) in which schools are located. County is a geographic administrative dimension, distinct from city even where a place name serves as both.
scope: County-based filtering and partitioning of schools.

name: City
definition: City or community of a school's physical address. City names overlap with county names (e.g. Riverside is both a city and a county), but the two dimensions select different sets of schools.

name: School CDS Code
definition: 14-character California Department of Education identifier that encodes county, district and school. Primary key of the school directory and of the FRPM table.
scope: School identity and cross-table linkage between tab01 and tab03.

name: SAT Record CDS Code
definition: CDS code attached to each SAT reporting record. Unlike the directory and FRPM tables, 211 records store the code with 13 characters by omitting the leading zero.
scope: Linkage between SAT records (tab02) and school entities.

name: Academic Year
definition: School year to which FRPM reporting applies. tab01 contains only 2014-2015.
scope: Temporal scope of FRPM and enrollment measures.

name: Charter Status
definition: Whether a school record is a charter school. Encoded as a 1/0 flag (1 = charter, 0 = not charter); NULL marks administrative or unspecified records without school-level attributes.

name: District Type
definition: Classification of the school district an entity belongs to, stored as a numeric code and a text label. 52 = Elementary School District, 54 = Unified School District, 56 = High School District, 00 = County Office of Education.

name: School Type
definition: Classification of a school's instructional level, stored as a numeric code and a text label. 60 = Elementary Schools (Public), 62 = Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public), 66 = High Schools (Public), 65 = K-12 Schools (Public).
scope: School-type filtering, including numeric codes such as ownership code 66.

name: School Status
definition: Operational status of a school directory record: Active, Closed, Merged or Pending.
scope: Filtering the school directory by lifecycle status; counts of schools depend on this status.

name: Virtual / Physical Building Status
definition: Whether a school offers a physical instructional building, encoded in fld075. F denotes exclusively virtual instruction with no physical building; N and P are other recorded values; NULL means no status was recorded.

name: K-12 Enrollment
definition: Number of students enrolled in kindergarten through grade 12 at a school for 2014-2015. In the workload's wording, grades 1 through 12 are treated as K-12.

name: Enrollment Ages 5-17
definition: Number of students aged 5 through 17 enrolled at a school for 2014-2015. This is a different population from K-12 enrollment and is always less than or equal to it in the observed data.

name: Enrollment Difference (K-12 vs Ages 5-17)
definition: Difference between K-12 enrollment and ages 5-17 enrollment for the same school and year.
scope: Comparing the two enrollment populations reported in tab01.

name: Free Meal Count (K-12)
definition: Number of K-12 students eligible for free meals at a school.

name: Free or Reduced-Price Meal Count (K-12)
definition: Number of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals at a school. It is greater than or equal to the free meal count.
scope: Free or reduced-price meal eligibility measure in tab01.
aliases: free or reduced price meal count

name: Percent Eligible Free (K-12)
definition: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free meals, stored as a fraction between 0 and 1. Equals free meal count divided by K-12 enrollment.

name: Percent Eligible FRPM (K-12)
definition: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free or reduced-price meals, stored as a fraction between 0 and 1. Equals FRPM count divided by K-12 enrollment.
scope: Free or reduced-price meal eligibility rate for K-12.
aliases: eligible free or reduced price meal rate
free or reduced price meal rate

name: SAT Average Reading Score
definition: Average SAT reading score reported for a school or district SAT record. NULL when no scores were reported.

name: SAT Average Math Score
definition: Average SAT math score reported for a school or district SAT record. NULL when no scores were reported.

name: SAT Average Writing Score
definition: Average SAT writing score reported for a school or district SAT record. NULL when no scores were reported.

name: SAT Report Record Type
definition: Level of a SAT reporting record: S = school-level, D = district-level. District-level records have no school name.
scope: Selecting school-level SAT records for school analysis.

name: Phone Number
definition: Telephone contact number of a school record. Also referred to as communication number.

name: Street Address
definition: Physical street address of the school location, available in full and abbreviated forms.

name: Mailing / Postal Street Address
definition: Mailing street address reported for the school, available in full and abbreviated forms. Referred to as the postal street address; it can differ from the physical street address.

name: School Open Date
definition: Date the school opened, as recorded in the school directory.
scope: Temporal filtering such as schools opened after a given year.

name: School Close Date
definition: Date the school closed. NULL for schools that have not closed.
scope: Temporal filtering such as schools closed before a given year.

name: Charter Funding Type
definition: Funding model recorded for charter schools: Directly funded, Locally funded, or Not in CS funding model. NULL for records without a reported charter funding model.
